# Lumina

> Lumina joins Zoom/Meet/Teams calls, records and transcribes them, and delivers a summary with decisions and action items automatically. Positioned on "never take meeting notes again."

## Pages

- [Lumina — The AI Meeting Assistant for Teams](https://127.0.0.1:44883/): Lumina records, transcribes, and summarizes your team's meetings, then turns them into action items automatically. Free for teams up to 5.
- [Blog — Lumina](https://127.0.0.1:44883/blog): The Lumina blog: articles on meetings, productivity, and teamwork.
